# Reader

> The open-source web infrastructure platform for AI. Scrape, crawl, and automate the web from a single API.

Reader converts any webpage into clean, LLM-ready markdown. Open-source (Apache 2.0), self-hostable.

## Core Primitives

- Read: Convert any URL to clean markdown via API or SDK
- Crawl: BFS crawl entire websites to markdown with depth/page limits
- Browse: CDP cloud browser sessions for AI agents (Playwright/Puppeteer compatible)
- Extract: Structured data extraction with LLMs (coming soon)

## Quick Start

API:
  curl https://api.reader.dev/v1/read \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer rdr_YOUR_KEY" \
    -d '{"urls": ["https://example.com"]}'

JavaScript:
  npm install @vakra-dev/reader-js

Python:
  pip install reader-py

CLI:
  npx @vakra-dev/reader-cli scrape https://example.com

Self-hosted:
  docker pull ghcr.io/vakra-dev/reader

## Packages

- @vakra-dev/reader (npm) - Core engine
- @vakra-dev/reader-js (npm) - JavaScript SDK
- @vakra-dev/reader-cli (npm) - CLI tool
- reader-py (PyPI) - Python SDK

## Technology

- Engine: Playwright with fingerprint-generator for stealth browsing
- Markdown: Supermarkdown (Rust HTML-to-markdown engine with NAPI bindings)
- Infrastructure: Docker containers with Caddy load balancer
- Proxy: Tiered proxy support (standard ISP + premium residential)
- Anti-detection: fingerprint-generator + proxy-chain + headless=new
